reason: Stream C1 (F1, F3, F4) changes provider-chat tool history: sticky clearing to a watermark in ChatService._with_tool_history and the context-length retry; checkpoint v3 receipts (step brief, 200-char summary, capacity-scaled byte bound, estimate_tokens) in chat_turn_ledger; a deterministic tool-activity block rendered from metadata.tool_results in _stored_model_text (with a new metadata brief written by _persist and turn outcomes); and the notes.write tool (ChatWorkingNotes entity, storage/API registration, components at turn creation and resume, routing guidance, turn-start injection, checkpoint inclusion, ContextStatus.working_notes). Selected: the new test_tool_history_memory.py; the in-turn replay/cache/clearing files (test_turn_prompt_cache, test_in_turn_context_pruning, test_chat_tool_loop, test_routing_prose_answer, test_gemini_call_ids, test_synthesis_tool_declarations, test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery, test_chat_routing_tolerance, test_restart_recovery_lifecycle, test_tool_failures, test_process_results_webhook); every prepare_async/prepare_resume path whose tool set now includes notes.write (test_chat, test_chat_api, test_tool_catalog, test_tool_suggestions, test_structured_results, test_chat_subagents, test_subagent_refusal_categories, test_chat_agent_messages, test_chat_goals, test_chat_schedules, test_browser_companion, test_web_search); stored-answer metadata and outcome notes (test_turn_outcome_history, test_turn_write_amplification); entity/API registration and deletion (test_generic_crud_exposure, test_domain, test_storage_waste, test_chat_workspace); and ContextStatus/context assembly, where the working notes join the reserve and follow retrieved excerpts (test_context, test_api_stream_context, test_chat_context_assembly). Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_minimal_agent_instructions.py is excluded: test_chat_instructions_only_define_turn_protocol already fails on origin/main (asserts 'finish_response' in the chat instructions), unrelated to this change. No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no ui/ or Rust changes and no visible UI change (the notes tool renders in the existing generic tool card with the spec display name; ContextStatus.working_notes is consumed by the separate mockup-approved UI stream). Harness chats, mission orchestration and provider adapter tests are excluded: harness turns do not use _stored_model_text, _with_tool_history or the ledger checkpoint, and no provider adapter changed. Real-Core evidence (OpenRouter deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash, host execution mode, 24K window, clearing events, notes, cross-turn tool_output.read, base A/B) is in the PR body. No full suite.
